mira (CS): Onboarding checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/lighthouse-health-onboard. Key owners: SE=ryan, Infra=mira, Security=ana.

legal-bot: BAA and co-marketing addendum uploaded to Legal queue (LQ-2243).
